description: This file defines synchronization utilities for API locking, including thread-local flags, lock management templates, and registration functions for API methods with locking mechanisms.

classes.name: ApiLocks
classes.description: Template struct managing a static recursive mutex for each class type to synchronize API access.

classes.name: UnlockApiGuard
classes.description: RAII guard that unlocks the class-specific mutex if the thread is using a locked API, and re-locks upon destruction.

classes.name: LockApiGuard
classes.description: RAII guard that manages locking and unlocking of the class-specific mutex.

methods.name: getFunctionToCall
methods.description: Creates a std::function that wraps a method call with mutex locking and exception handling.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApi
methods.description: Registers an API method with locking support for a specific object.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApiForVersions
methods.description: Registers an API method with versioning support.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApiForHandler
methods.description: Registers an API method with a JSONRPC handler.
